dgm.text: Bartek is a laborer who, in Dragon's Maze, finishes loading Boss Zifka's cart and is paid a zino, keeping quiet about mismatched crates. He then haggles with Imrich on Tin Street and buys a pewter ornament for eighty zibs, though Nico warns him that Andra is only after his money and Bartek shoves him aside.
Bartek gives Andra the ornament as a gift, and she hooks it to her headband, then sells him a dark dagger for five zinos, leaving him with one zino.

The next morning Bartek arrives bruised, having been jumped on his way to work and robbed of the dagger. Andra explains her trick of selling an illicit item and then arranging for it to be stolen, and that she asked the buyer to leave Bartek alive.
